title: A session that wrote to another one with a plain `hub send` and waits for its answer says `hub waiting` — then the core forwards it the turn result of the one that answered; on a plain report or an FYI — it does not say it
note: System prompt — plugins/hub-base/skills/hub/SKILL.md (the same in both versions). The difference is in the core's note "The hub was updated — what changed for sessions" on the incoming message (core/news.unseen): "before" — only the earlier item under the same date, "after" — it plus the new "### For sessions" item from PR #321. No tools: we judge by the turn's listed commands. ask-* — the answer is needed for the next step (it waits), report-* — a message after which there is nothing to wait for.

commands.description: all the shell commands you run in this turn, in order, exactly as you would type them, until the end of the turn

says.description: the text of your result for this turn

input.before:
You are the hub's maps agent: you run the map style. The hub's tiles session runs tile re-rendering.

[hub:m501 from user] Find out from the tiles session how many region 3 tiles are still not re-rendered after the style change, and based on its number decide whether to roll out the style today.

(The hub was updated — what changed for sessions:
• Another hub's answer to a request you sent through the liaison (`hub send liaison --to <contact> "…"`) comes to you by itself; there is no need to ask the liaison to pass it on.
Do it this way, even if earlier in the conversation it was different.)
input.after:

Do it this way, even if earlier in the conversation it was different.)
